Format synonyms for a Synonym-tagged column

Source: R/synonym_lists.R
format_synonyms.Rd

Joins synonyms into the "a; b; c" form that a "Synonym" column expects. Commas never separate synonyms (they occur inside names such as "Benzene, 1,2-dichloro-"), so build the cell with this helper rather than pasting by hand.

Usage

format_synonyms(x)

Arguments

x

A list (for example a list column) with one character vector of synonyms per row, giving one string per element; or an atomic character vector, which is a single row's synonyms and gives one string.

Value

Character vector. Empty or all-NA elements give NA_character_. A synonym containing ; outside brackets cannot be represented, so its semicolons become commas, with a warning. A synonym with an unbalanced parenthesis or bracket also warns, because it makes its whole cell unsplittable.

Examples

format_synonyms(c("EDB", "Ethylene dibromide"))
#> [1] "EDB; Ethylene dibromide"
format_synonyms(list(c("o-DCB", "ortho-Dichlorobenzene"), NA))
#> [1] "o-DCB; ortho-Dichlorobenzene" NA
